CustomField.description: Whether the address is in use now (Current), was used before (Former), or has mail coming back (Undeliverable). A move sets Former on the address it replaces; only a person sets Undeliverable. A blank, on an address saved before this field existed, reads as Current (R-AD10).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Current: in use now. Former: used before. Undeliverable: mail sent here comes back; set by a person, never automatically.
CustomField.label: Status
